Section 1 - Scope of Work
The Design-Builder shall provide all labor, materials, and equipment required to
complete the Riverside Community Library renovation, including structural
upgrades, mechanical replacement, and accessibility improvements.

Schedule 7 — Mandatory Demonstration Protocol
Schedule 14 – Validation, Assurance and Deliverable Requirements
Schedule 15: Output Specifications
Section 2.1 Technical Specification;
Schedule 20 Financial Submission Forms

Section 2.2 — Proponents shall submit a design narrative describing the
proposed methodology for the mechanical replacement scope, including a
compliance matrix demonstrating conformance to Schedule 15.

3.2 Background. CMC information is presently distributed among multiple
document classes and systems, and design records are currently maintained
across several legacy repositories. The existing systems do not currently
interoperate, and the Sponsor has historically relied on manual document
tracking for schedule and specification changes.

Section 3 - Financial Submission
Proponents shall complete the attached pricing form, including all
applicable taxes, escalation allowances, and a financial security bond in
the amount specified in Schedule 20.

Each Proponent shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and
submission of its Proposal, including travel and attendance at any
meetings, and shall be responsible for all due diligence costs incurred in
preparing a response.

Section 4 - Schedule
Substantial performance shall be achieved no later than 18 months after
contract award. The Sponsor reserves the right to amend this timetable at
its sole discretion.

Section 9 - Completion Requirements
The Design-Builder shall achieve total performance within 14 months of the
Notice to Proceed, and shall submit a final validation and demonstration
report no later than 80 Business Days after Commercial Close.

All structural steel shall conform to CSA G40.21 350W, as indicated on the
structural drawings. Any material deviation from the technical requirements
may result in disqualification.
